title: The Lavender Kitchen Counter Glow-Up
description: A lavender kitchen counter from Walmart: the Beautiful by Drew Barrymore air fryer, toaster, coffee maker, stand mixer, silicone tool set and mix and measure set, all in lavender with gold.
intro: I did not need a new toaster. I needed my counter to stop looking like a storage unit. So I went lavender, all of it, gold handles and everything, and now I walk into the kitchen just to look at it. Coffee in the morning, cookie dough on Saturday, and somehow the mixer never goes back in the cabinet. It is the cheapest glow-up in my house and the one everyone asks about.

sections.heading: The big three
paragraphs: The 6 qt air fryer, the 3.5 qt tilt-head stand mixer and the 12-cup programmable coffee maker. Matte lavender, gold handles, and they look like they belong together because they do.

sections.heading: The little ones that finish it
paragraphs: The 2-slice touch toaster, the 6-piece silicone tool set in its ceramic crock, and the 14-piece mix and measure set with nesting bowls, measuring spoons, a whisk and a spatula.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, food and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
